# opencode-claude-auth

> An OpenCode plugin that authenticates the Anthropic provider with Claude Code
> subscription credentials from the macOS Keychain, and balances requests across
> several Claude accounts — rotating off one when its quota is spent, without
> re-authenticating and without interrupting the agent.

This is a **fork** of `griffinmartin/opencode-claude-auth`, tracked as the
`upstream` remote and merged from periodically. That fact shapes the layout:
files upstream also owns stay where upstream put them, and the fork's own code
lives in domain folders. See `AGENTS.md` for the rules this imposes on changes.

Runtime facts worth knowing before reading code:

- Zero runtime dependencies. `@opencode-ai/plugin` is a peer, and it is imported
  for a value in exactly one module (`src/ui/tools.ts`), loaded dynamically.
- Source is TypeScript with `.ts` import specifiers, compiled to `dist/` by
  `tsc`. OpenCode loads `dist/`, so editing `src/` changes nothing until a build.
- Tests run under `node --test --experimental-strip-types`. OpenCode itself runs
  on Bun. Anything added must work under both.
- The access token is resolved **per request** inside the plugin's own `fetch`,
  which is why switching accounts takes effect on the next call with no provider
  reload and nothing cancelled.

## Entry point

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): the plugin. Registers the `auth` hook (provider
  loader + the account switcher), the `config` hook (account label), the request
  path (custom `fetch`, retries, beta exclusion, quota capture), and the tools.
  Upstream-owned and the largest module; prefer adding to a domain folder.

## Balancing (fork-owned)

- [src/balance/balancer.ts](src/balance/balancer.ts): pure decision logic — health
  assessment, pools as failover tiers, and eight strategies behind one registry.
  No I/O and no clock; everything is a function of (members, quota, config, now).
- [src/balance/rotate.ts](src/balance/rotate.ts): the side-effecting half. Reads
  config at each decision, which is what keeps strategy and presets hot-reloadable.
- [src/balance/quota.ts](src/balance/quota.ts): parses `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-*`
  response headers into a per-account cache. The 5h/7d windows and their reset epochs.
- [src/balance/usage.ts](src/balance/usage.ts): append-only JSONL telemetry —
  requests served, refusals, latency, rotations.

## Credentials (upstream-owned)

- [src/credentials.ts](src/credentials.ts): account list, active-account selection,
  refresh, `auth.json` sync.
- [src/keychain.ts](src/keychain.ts): reads Claude Code credentials from the macOS
  Keychain, including per-directory suffixed entries.
- [src/refresh-lock.ts](src/refresh-lock.ts): per-account lock so concurrent
  sessions cannot revoke each other's tokens.
- [src/signing.ts](src/signing.ts): request signing helpers.

## Request shaping (upstream-owned)

- [src/transforms.ts](src/transforms.ts): body/stream transforms for API compatibility.
- [src/betas.ts](src/betas.ts): anthropic-beta header management and long-context fallback.
- [src/model-config.ts](src/model-config.ts): per-model configuration.

## Presentation (fork-owned)

- [src/ui/display.ts](src/ui/display.ts): decorates provider and model names with
  the active account.
- [src/ui/advisory.ts](src/ui/advisory.ts): turns notices into toasts.
- [src/ui/tools.ts](src/ui/tools.ts): the `claude_auth_status` / `claude_auth_select`
  / `claude_auth_usage` tools.
- [src/notify.ts](src/notify.ts): the notice types and sink. Stays at the root
  because upstream's `credentials.ts` imports it.

## Cross-cutting

- [src/config.ts](src/config.ts): layered config (defaults < user file < project
  file < inline < env), re-read on a stat check so edits apply without a restart.
- [src/logger.ts](src/logger.ts): structured JSONL debug log with key-based
  redaction of credential fields.

## Operator surfaces

- [scripts/lb.ts](scripts/lb.ts): `pnpm lb` — select preset/account/auto by
  writing the selection file. Safe mid-task.
- [scripts/usage-report.ts](scripts/usage-report.ts): `pnpm usage` — per-account report.
- [scripts/test-rotation-headless.ts](scripts/test-rotation-headless.ts):
  `pnpm test:rotation` — real `opencode run` end-to-end rotation assertions.
- [scripts/test-headless.ts](scripts/test-headless.ts): `pnpm test:headless` —
  credential refresh flows against a sandboxed fake keychain.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): install, configuration reference, strategies, presets.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules a change must follow, and how they are checked.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
